traits.d: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.n: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.d: If the boar takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

tips: Слабый спасбросок: Интеллект (-4) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
